title: MatSek experience.md frontmatter v1
description: YAML frontmatter of experience.md (parsed to JSON before validation). Experience bundles have no manifest.json — this frontmatter IS the manifest. The body below it is free text. Authorship and license ride on git history, not frontmatter.

tool.description: Which tool the report is about, e.g. "ai-learner".

tool_version.description: Version string verbatim from the tool.

consent_public.description: Publication gate: only reports with true may appear anywhere public.

session_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the session the report is about, for reproduction.

^x_.description: Tool-private extension keys. Always allowed; tools that rewrite the file must preserve them.
